definitions.explanation: The branch of medicine dealing with teeth and oral health, or a clinic or department specializing in dental care.

examples.japanese: {歯科|しか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I had a checkup at the dentist.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{歯科|しか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: My tooth hurts, so I made an appointment at the dental clinic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{歯科|しか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{定期|ていき}{検診|けんしん}→定期検診：15678_teikikenshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I make sure to get a regular dental checkup once every six months.

notes:
USAGE:
In everyday speech, {歯科|しか} and ⟦{歯医者|はいしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧ (dentist) are often used interchangeably when referring to a dental clinic. {歯科|しか} is slightly more formal and refers to the discipline or department, while ⟦{歯医者|はいしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧ is more colloquial and refers to the dentist or the office.

RELATED MEDICAL DEPARTMENTS:
- ⟦{眼科|がんか}→眼科：11071_ganka⟧: ophthalmology
- ⟦{皮膚科|ひふか}→皮膚科：11073_hifuka⟧: dermatology
- ⟦{内科|ないか}→内科：04076_naika⟧: internal medicine
- ⟦{外科|げか}→外科：03983_geka⟧: surgery

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{歯科医|しかい}→歯科医：19394_shikai⟧: dentist (formal)
- {歯科|しか}{衛生士|えいせいし}: dental hygienist
- {歯科|しか}⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧: dental checkup
- {歯科|しか}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: dental treatment
